meta.name: Heroes Of The East
meta.description: When a series of martial misunderstandings spirals into an international incident,  a Chinese martial arts student struggling to relate to his new Japanese wife is forced to take on seven of Japan's most powerful martial arts masters, each an expert in a different discipline, ranging from karate to samurai to ninjitsu.
meta.slogan: There is nothing more terrifying than the ninja... except death!
